_about: Gain fragment (List 19 #177) — the yield/split layer under the battle-end learning interface #158 fixed (one event per Ranger-side participant, consumed by #129). No constant is set: species yields, class weights, the yield function's constants, and the rounding rule are all OPEN for the owner balance pass. Versus/facility exclusions and the rental confinement are structural rules, stated in the spec, not data.

model.accumulation: gain events append to the individual record as facts {battleRef, amount}; the accumulated total is the derived sum (#14/#96 law), never a stored counter
model.captureJoin: a battle ending in a #38 keep draws its pool only from opponents defeated before the keep; the kept individual contributes no yield

exclusions.facility: #86 formats incl. #186 ladder produce no gain events (levels normalised; the record is the reward)
exclusions.opponentSide: AI parties are authored data (#52 B2); their levels are facts, not grown totals — they earn nothing
exclusions.rental: #159: events, if any, fire inside the run record only and expire with it; no borrowed individual carries gain out
exclusions.versus: #109 Ranger-vs-Ranger formats produce no gain events

model.faintedParticipants: participation is the criterion — a participant who fainted earns exactly as one who stood (class switched)

participantClasses.active: on the field at battle end
participantClasses.party-share: never fielded; earns only if a share mechanism (shareSource) covers it
participantClasses.switched: fielded, then switched out or fainted

model.pool: one member per defeated opposing individual: f(species gainYield, opponent level as emitted by #52); fled/escaped opponents contribute nothing
model.split: the whole pool divides by class weights: share = pool x weight(class) / sum of weights; equal weights express the classic even split

yieldFunction.shape: species yield scaled by opponent level

open_register: gainYield values for every species (and the field's acceptance into the species record — proposed here, its home disposes)
the rounding rule for division (game-lane implementation fact, to be stated not assumed)
whether any share mechanism exists at all (shareSource) — item-mediated via #31/#183 or format rule

speciesFieldProposal.status: PROPOSED — no species carries a yield value today

landingFill.rule: Filled at landing under the owner's Pokemon-base rule (2026-10-27): mechanics are filled the way Pokemon does it; Jamar's canon overrides where it speaks. Recorded here, not silent.
landingFill.yieldFunction: pool member per defeated opponent = floor(gainYield x opponentLevel / 7) — the classic Pokemon divisor; gainYield itself stays species data (values are data-lane work, like base stats).
landingFill.shareSource: item-mediated, Pokemon-style: a party-share individual earns a participant's share only while a share item covers it (the Exp. Share pattern, via #31/#183); otherwise party-share earns nothing.
landingFill.rounding: floor at every division step (Pokemon floors).
landingFill.split: the pool divides across earning participants by the weights above — equal weights = the classic even split.
